S2.3.3.3 lists the residual dimension of every edge (X, Y, centre, side, scratch rows) matching the paper table, S2.3.3 claims all edge labels nested and nondegenerate, and the quote at line 1033 is a row of the table.

S2.3.3.6 shows every nonzero binary residual is nonalternating via a norm-one coordinate vector outside earlier supports and concludes an orthonormal basis (quoting line 1087); the plan does not spell out the absorption of alternating planes, only the conclusion.
S2.4.1 states weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors and q_V-q_U = sum over an orthonormal basis of wt(v)[v.x] mod 4.
S2.4.2 gives wt(v) odd so coefficient eps in {1,-1}; S2.4.3 gives the phase i^{eps[v.x]} as (1+i^eps)/2+(1-i^eps)/2 (-1)^{v.x} and, via H diag(1,-1) H = X, the kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse.

S2.6.2 gives the elimination proof (topmost nonzero row, rightmost entry as pivot, clearing left by right and below by left lower-triangular elementary matrices, scale, delete and repeat) and S2.6.1 says Pi has exactly a ones.

summary: 25 of 26 sub-steps present, 1 absent (P3), 0 wrong. The plan carries the bank-exchange, residual-budget, rank-saving, matrix-shear and guard-width derivations in detail; the one gap is the k-column tensoring of each edge frame (one factor per residual vector, s_c in all). Mild leniency calls: L4 (orthonormal basis stated without the absorption of alternating planes), P4 (zero/full label frames not stated explicitly) and M2 (finite table implicit).
